title: Tabletop-to-live progressive promotion and KV gatekeeper rehearsal
creator: Ethan Park
description: Goal: run a mixed tabletop-to-live DR rehearsal that validates our incremental warm-promotion approach for an active->passive region swap while exercising KV snapshot reconciliation, circuit-breaker thresholds, and prioritized load-shedding. This ticket produces a reproducible playbook, a checklist of observability gates (the KV Gatekeeper), and a schedule for a staged drill that transitions from human-led decisions to automated gating. Scope excludes full database cross-region failover (DB team owns schema-level restore) but includes tokenstore/KV, caches, routing, and inference-serving concerns.
acceptance_criteria: A runbook exists that can be executed by a two-shift on-call team with clear roles (Conductor, KV Lead, Traffic Lead, Observability Lead, Rollback Lead)
KV Gatekeeper check(s) validate snapshot integrity and key reconciliation within tolerance (<=0.1% key mismatch) before traffic promotion
Automated smoke tests (latency P95, error rate) run against promoted region and meet SLO gates for 15 minutes at each traffic increment
Circuit breaker bloom thresholds are exercised and adjusted to avoid cascading failure during the slow-start traffic ramp
End-to-end restore from snapshot to passive region completes and is verified in <2x expected time and is idempotent for repeated runs
Post-drill retro with action items and owners created within 72 hours
runbook_steps: Pre-drill: notify stakeholders, snapshot tokenstore/KV, capture current traffic weights and SLO baselines
Tabletop: walk through roles, failure hypotheses, safety gates, and rollback criteria for 30 minutes
Stage 1 (Warmup): deploy passive region with runtime binaries, ingest a read-only KV snapshot, start services with network egress disabled
KV Gatekeeper: run reconciliation script and gating checks (checksum sampling, key cardinality, hot-key detection). If mismatch >0.1% or hot-key skew >10x, fail and run remediation steps
Stage 2 (Canary traffic): enable a 1% slow path traffic slice to passive region via weight-based routing; monitor smoke tests for 15 minutes
Stage 3 (Progressive ramp): increase traffic in defined increments (1%, 5%, 20%, 50%) with minimum observation windows (15m at each step); apply prioritized load-shedding rules as load increases
Circuit breaker tuning: at each traffic step validate CB trip counts and latency buckets; adjust thresholds documented in runtime-config if necessary
Full promotion: once 50% sustained traffic meets gates for 30m, run final KV consistency snapshot, flip active tag, and move load to promoted region per policy
Post-promotion: run end-to-end validation checks (batch job completeness, background KV compaction, index rebuilds) and keep fallback route enabled for 60 minutes
Rollback: if any high-severity gate fails, immediately revert traffic weights to original region, annotate incident runbook, and archive observability traces for root-cause analysis
verification_steps: KV integrity: compare sampled checksums across origin and promoted region; report mismatch percentage and top 10 mismatched keys
Performance: P50/P95/P99 token-gen latency vs baseline, error rate <= baseline + 0.5%, throughput within 10% of target
SLO probe: synthetic user journeys (chat generation, embedding request) run every 30s and must succeed with correct schema and within thresholds
Circuit breakers: record CB trigger count, recovery time, and any correlated increase in error budget consumption
Load-shedding validation: confirm that prioritized shedding dropped non-critical routes (background evals, long-running batches) before critical inference paths
Data durability: confirm last-consistent snapshot timestamp is within allowed RPO and that restore produced no orphaned keys
rollback_plan: Pre-defined rollback uses traffic weight rollback + tagging. Conductor calls Traffic Lead to reduce weights by half every 30s back to origin region until 100% restored, then run a quick KV drift check and mark incident. If KV drift discovered post-rollback, escalate to KV Lead to run targeted repair. All rollback actions logged and appended to ticket. Rollback must be idempotent and automated scripts available for manual invocation.
schedule: Dry run (tabletop) scheduled 2026-03-18 14:00-15:00 UTC. Live rehearsal window (non-business-impacting) scheduled 2026-03-20 02:00-05:00 UTC. Backout/contingency window reserved 2026-03-20 05:00-06:00 UTC.
